description:
Approve a supplier's proof (issues a certificate naming both companies and the evidence fingerprints,
sealed on chain, with a public verify page and badge) or reject it with a reason. Requires the
organization API key.

approve.description: true issues the certificate; false rejects
approve.title: Approve

reason.description: Required when rejecting, so the supplier can fix it
reason.title: Reason

name: supplier_proof_decide
title: Supplier Proof: approve or reject
